arStrings.szText: We are but fawns, and he is the stag. We are but calves, and he is the bull.
Confident and clear. Speaking to a crowd of pilgrims. In contrast to Bnatros' earlier preaching, Adone is good at this.
We are but pups, and he is the wolf!
Confident and clear. Speaking to a crowd of pilgrims. In contrast to Bnatros' earlier preaching, Adone is good at this.
Through Akarat, the Askari can fulfill their true destiny.
